name: HN Search by Algolia (hn.algolia.com API v1)
operator: Algolia, Inc. (Hacker News search index run for Y Combinator)
tier_rationale: Algolia, Inc. is an established company with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted); P109 cond 4 'Registry providers hacker_news (Y Combinator) and algolia: tier trusted, terms open'.

reliability.justification: Search index of public Hacker News items, refreshed continuously; it mirrors the Firebase API (same upstream family) and answers HTTP 500 for unknown users (P109 research C0250).

hn_search.title: HN Search API v1: search_by_date?tags=author_<u> (activity) and search?query= (org_profile domain/brand mentions)

terms.quote: Registry providers hacker_news (Y Combinator) and algolia: tier trusted, terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

hn_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P109 cond 4); research C0250 '[live_osint] Documented 10,000 requests/hour per IP' (booked through the quota block, P109 cond 3). users/<u> answers 500 HTML for unknown users (observed 2026-11-26): never used for absence, the Firebase 'null' body decides (P109 cond 1).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-1 (P109 hackernews). Same upstream family as hacker_news.firebase_api (it indexes the same items): consensus never counts both. Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review is still to be recorded before default use (P109 cond 4).
